title: The Impact of Regulatory Changes on Rating Shopping and Rating Catering Behavior in the European Securitization Market
Bail-in in action
As interest rates surge: flighty deposits and lending
Business as usual: bank climate commitments, lending, and engagement
abstract: This paper studies the impact of voluntary climate commitments by banks on their lending activity. We use administrative data on the universe of bank lending from 19 European countries. There is strong selection into commitments, with increased participation by the largest banks and banks with the most pre-existing exposure to high-polluting industries. Setting a commitment leads to a boost in a lender’s ESG rating. Lenders reduce credit in sectors they have targeted as high priority for decarbonization. However, climate-aligned banks do not change their lending or loan pricing differentially compared to banks without climate commitments, suggesting they are not actively divesting. We can reject that climate-aligned lenders divest from firms in targeted sectors by more than 2.6%. Firm borrowers are no more likely to set climate targets after their lender sets a climate target, which casts doubt on active engagement by lenders. These results call into question the efficacy of voluntary commitments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究银行自愿性气候承诺对其放贷活动的影响。我们使用来自19个欧洲国家全部银行贷款的行政数据。银行对承诺的选择存在明显的自选择，参与者主要是规模最大的银行以及此前在高污染行业敞口最大的银行。作出承诺后，贷款机构的ESG评级会提高。在被列为脱碳优先行业的领域，贷款机构会减少信贷。然而，气候导向型银行的放贷或贷款定价相较于没有气候承诺的银行并无差异变化，这表明它们并未积极撤资。我们可以拒绝气候导向型贷款机构从目标行业企业撤资超过2.6%的假设。借款企业在其贷款机构设定气候目标后，设定气候目标的可能性并未提高，这使人怀疑贷款机构是否真正积极介入。这些结果对自愿性承诺的有效性提出了质疑。

title: The climate and the economy
abstract: Climate change and the public policies to arrest it are and will continue reshaping the global economy. This Discussion Paper draws on economic research to identify some key medium- and long-run economic implications of these developments. It explores implications for growth, innovation, inflation, financial markets, fiscal policy, and several socio-economic outcomes. The main message that emerges is that climate change will cause income divergence across individuals, sectors, and regions, adjustment in energy markets, increased inflation variability, financial markets stress, intensified innovation, increased migration, and rising public debt. These challenges appear manageable for EU member states, especially under an early and orderly transition scenario. At the same time, the direction, scope, and speed of economic transformation is subject to large uncertainty due to two separate factors: the wide range of climate scenarios for a given trajectory of greenhouse gas emissions and the exact policy path governments choose, especially in the context of the ongoing Russian aggression in Ukraine.
abstract_zh: 气候变化及为遏制其而实施的公共政策正在并将持续重塑全球经济。本讨论稿借鉴经济学研究，识别这些发展在中长期的若干关键经济影响。文章探讨了其对增长、创新、通胀、金融市场、财政政策以及若干社会经济结果的影响。主要结论是，气候变化将导致个人、行业和地区之间的收入分化，引起能源市场调整，增加通胀波动，加剧金融市场压力，推动创新加速，促进人口迁移，并推高公共债务。这些挑战对欧盟成员国而言似乎是可以应对的，尤其是在早期且有序的转型情景下。与此同时，经济转型的方向、范围和速度存在很大不确定性，原因有两个：一是在给定温室气体排放路径下气候情景范围很广；二是政府最终选择的政策路径，尤其是在俄罗斯持续入侵乌克兰的背景下。
